articles.title: gitgalaxy — Updated!
articles.summary: GitGalaxy is a new software tool designed for efficient code analysis, scanning projects across over 50 languages without compilation. It identifies 97 structural signals and generates 19 risk exposure scores, culminating in six detailed reports. This dependency-free tool, easily installable via pip, aims to streamline code security and quality assessments, addressing common development pain points.

articles.title: Wave of mass market credit cards erodes foreign majors’ base
articles.summary: The combined credit card base of American Express, HSBC India, Standard Chartered Bank, DBS Bank India, and SBM Bank India declined 7.1% year-on-year to 3.99 million by the end of June. This contraction among major foreign and private banks indicates evolving consumer credit behavior and market dynamics within India, a relevant economic trend for aspiring officers to understand.

articles.title: Lanterns: Here's Our Updated Season 1 Episode 2: "Trust Fall" Preview
articles.summary: HBO's new series 'Lanterns,' starring Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre, progresses its complex narrative in the second episode, 'Trust Fall.' The mystery deepens across two distinct timelines, challenging viewers to piece together the unfolding plot. This episode continues to develop key character arcs and the overarching story, keeping audiences engaged with its intricate world.

articles.title: Not opposed to theatrisation, but don’t shake up system by picking it up from somewhere: IAF chief
articles.summary: Indian Air Force Chief Air Chief Marshal A Singh affirmed that the IAF is not against theaterisation, a major defence reform. However, he stressed the importance of developing an indigenous model rather than directly replicating foreign ones. This indicates a focus on adapting the joint command structure to India's unique operational needs and strategic environment, ensuring optimized integration of the three services for future warfare.
